1.yusuf_ali: When the Event inevitable cometh to pass,
1.shakir: When the great event comes to pass,
1.mohsin_khan: When the Event (i.e. the Day of Resurrection) befalls.

2.sahih_international: There is, at its occurrence, no denial.
2.pickthall: There is no denying that it will befall -
2.yusuf_ali: Then will no (soul) entertain falsehood concerning its coming.
2.shakir: There is no belying its coming to pass--
2.muhammad_sarwar: no soul will deny its coming.
2.mohsin_khan: And there can be no denying of its befalling.

3.sahih_international: It will bring down [some] and raise up [others].
3.yusuf_ali: (Many) will it bring low; (many) will it exalt;
3.muhammad_sarwar: It will abase some and exalt others.
3.mohsin_khan: It will bring low (some); (and others) it will exalt;

4.sahih_international: When the earth is shaken with convulsion
4.pickthall: When the earth is shaken with a shock
4.yusuf_ali: When the earth shall be shaken to its depths,
4.shakir: When the earth shall be shaken with a (severe) shaking,
4.muhammad_sarwar: When the earth is violently shaken
4.mohsin_khan: When the earth will be shaken with a terrible shake.
4.arberry: when the earth shall be rocked

5.sahih_international: And the mountains are broken down, crumbling
5.pickthall: And the hills are ground to powder
5.yusuf_ali: And the mountains shall be crumbled to atoms,
5.shakir: And the mountains shall be made to crumble with (an awful) crumbling,
5.mohsin_khan: And the mountains will be powdered to dust.

6.pickthall: So that they become a scattered dust,
6.shakir: So that they shall be as scattered dust.
6.muhammad_sarwar: they will become like dust scattered around.
6.mohsin_khan: So that they will become floating dust particles.

7.pickthall: And ye will be three kinds:
7.yusuf_ali: And ye shall be sorted out into three classes.
7.shakir: And you shall be three sorts.
7.muhammad_sarwar: On that day, you (mankind) will be divided into three groups:
7.mohsin_khan: And you (all) will be in three kinds (i.e. separate groups).
7.arberry: and you shall be three bands --

8.sahih_international: Then the companions of the right - what are the companions of the right?
8.pickthall: (First) those on the right hand; what of those on the right hand?
8.yusuf_ali: Then (there will be) the Companions of the Right Hand;- What will be the Companions of the Right Hand?
8.shakir: Then (as to) the companions of the right hand; how happy are the companions of the right hand!
8.muhammad_sarwar: The people of the right hand - those whose books of records will be placed in their right hands. How happy they will be!
8.mohsin_khan: So those on the Right Hand (i.e. those who will be given their Records in their right hands), Who will be those on the Right Hand? (As a respect for them, because they will enter Paradise).
8.arberry: Companions of the Right (O Companions of the Right!)

9.sahih_international: And the companions of the left - what are the companions of the left?
9.pickthall: And (then) those on the left hand; what of those on the left hand?
9.yusuf_ali: And the Companions of the Left Hand,- what will be the Companions of the Left Hand?
9.shakir: And (as to) the companions of the left hand; how wretched are the companions of the left hand!
9.muhammad_sarwar: The people of the left hand - those whose books of records will be placed in their left hands. How miserable they will be!
9.mohsin_khan: And those on the Left Hand (i.e. those who will be given their Record in their left hands), Who will be those on the Left Hand? (As a disgrace for them, because they will enter Hell).
9.arberry: Companions of the Left (O Companions of the Left!)

10.pickthall: And the foremost in the race, the foremost in the race:
10.yusuf_ali: And those Foremost (in Faith) will be Foremost (in the Hereafter).
10.shakir: And the foremost are the foremost,
10.muhammad_sarwar: The foremost ones (in faith and virtue) - the foremost ones in receiving their reward.
10.mohsin_khan: And those foremost [(in Islamic Faith of Monotheism and in performing righteous deeds) in the life of this world on the very first call for to embrace Islam,] will be foremost (in Paradise).

11.sahih_international: Those are the ones brought near [to Allah]
11.pickthall: Those are they who will be brought nigh
11.yusuf_ali: These will be those Nearest to Allah:
11.shakir: These are they who are drawn nigh (to Allah),
11.muhammad_sarwar: (The foremost ones) will be the nearest ones to God
11.mohsin_khan: These will be those nearest to Allah.
11.arberry: those are they brought nigh the Throne,

13.sahih_international: A [large] company of the former peoples
13.pickthall: A multitude of those of old
13.yusuf_ali: A number of people from those of old,
13.shakir: A numerous company from among the first,
13.muhammad_sarwar: Many of them will be from the ancient people
13.mohsin_khan: A multitude of those (foremost) will be from the first generations (who embraced Islam).

14.sahih_international: And a few of the later peoples,
14.pickthall: And a few of those of later time.
14.yusuf_ali: And a few from those of later times.
14.shakir: And a few from among the latter.
14.muhammad_sarwar: and only a few of them from the later generations.
14.mohsin_khan: And a few of those (foremost) will be from the later time (generations).
14.arberry: and how few of the later folk)

15.yusuf_ali: (They will be) on Thrones encrusted (with gold and precious stones),
15.muhammad_sarwar: They will recline on jewelled couches
15.mohsin_khan: (They will be) on thrones woven with gold and precious stones,

16.sahih_international: Reclining on them, facing each other.
16.yusuf_ali: Reclining on them, facing each other.
16.shakir: Reclining on them, facing one another.
16.arberry: reclining upon them, set face to face,

17.sahih_international: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal
17.pickthall: There wait on them immortal youths
17.yusuf_ali: Round about them will (serve) youths of perpetual (freshness),
17.shakir: Round about them shall go youths never altering in age,
17.mohsin_khan: They will be served by immortal boys,
17.arberry: immortal youths going round about them

18.sahih_international: With vessels, pitchers and a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring -
18.pickthall: With bowls and ewers and a cup from a pure spring
18.yusuf_ali: With goblets, (shining) beakers, and cups (filled) out of clear-flowing fountains:
18.shakir: With goblets and ewers and a cup of pure drink;
18.muhammad_sarwar: with goblets, jugs and cups of crystal clear wine
18.mohsin_khan: With cups, and jugs, and a glass from the flowing wine,
18.arberry: with goblets, and ewers, and a cup from a spring

19.sahih_international: No headache will they have therefrom, nor will they be intoxicated -
19.pickthall: Wherefrom they get no aching of the head nor any madness,
19.yusuf_ali: No after-ache will they receive therefrom, nor will they suffer intoxication:
19.shakir: They shall not be affected with headache thereby, nor shall they get exhausted,
19.muhammad_sarwar: which will not cause them any intoxication or illness.
19.mohsin_khan: Wherefrom they will get neither any aching of the head, nor any intoxication.

20.sahih_international: And fruit of what they select
20.yusuf_ali: And with fruits, any that they may select:
20.shakir: And fruits such as they choose,
20.muhammad_sarwar: Also, they will be served with the fruits of their choice
20.mohsin_khan: And fruit; that they may choose.
20.arberry: and such fruits as they shall choose,

21.sahih_international: And the meat of fowl, from whatever they desire.
21.pickthall: And flesh of fowls that they desire.
21.yusuf_ali: And the flesh of fowls, any that they may desire.
21.shakir: And the flesh of fowl such as they desire.
21.muhammad_sarwar: and the flesh of birds, as they desire.
21.mohsin_khan: And the flesh of fowls that they desire.
21.arberry: and such flesh of fowl as they desire,

22.sahih_international: And [for them are] fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes,
22.pickthall: And (there are) fair ones with wide, lovely eyes,
22.yusuf_ali: And (there will be) Companions with beautiful, big, and lustrous eyes,-
22.muhammad_sarwar: They will have maidens with large, lovely black and white eyes,
22.mohsin_khan: And (there will be) Houris (fair females) with wide, lovely eyes (as wives for the pious),

23.shakir: The like of the hidden pearls:
23.muhammad_sarwar: like pearls preserved in their shells,
23.arberry: as the likeness of hidden pearls,

24.sahih_international: As reward for what they used to do.
24.pickthall: Reward for what they used to do.
24.yusuf_ali: A Reward for the deeds of their past (life).
24.shakir: A reward for what they used to do.
24.mohsin_khan: A reward for what they used to do.
24.arberry: a recompense for that they laboured.

25.sahih_international: They will not hear therein ill speech or commission of sin -
25.pickthall: There hear they no vain speaking nor recrimination
25.yusuf_ali: Not frivolity will they hear therein, nor any taint of ill,-
25.shakir: They shall not hear therein vain or sinful discourse,
25.muhammad_sarwar: They will not hear any unnecessary or sinful talk
25.mohsin_khan: No Laghw (dirty, false, evil vain talk) will they hear therein, nor any sinful speech (like backbiting, etc.).
25.arberry: Therein they shall hear no idle talk, no cause of sin,

26.pickthall: (Naught) but the saying: Peace, (and again) Peace.
26.muhammad_sarwar: except each other's greetings of, "Peace be with you".
26.mohsin_khan: But only the saying of: Salam!, Salam! (greetings with peace)!

27.sahih_international: The companions of the right - what are the companions of the right?
27.pickthall: And those on the right hand; what of those on the right hand?
27.yusuf_ali: The Companions of the Right Hand,- what will be the Companions of the Right Hand?
27.shakir: And the companions of the right hand; how happy are the companions of the right hand!
27.muhammad_sarwar: As for the people of the right hand, how happy they will be!
27.mohsin_khan: And those on the Right Hand, Who will be those on the Right Hand?
27.arberry: The Companions of the Right (O Companions of the Right!)

28.sahih_international: [They will be] among lote trees with thorns removed
28.yusuf_ali: (They will be) among Lote-trees without thorns,
28.muhammad_sarwar: They will live amid the thornless lot trees

29.yusuf_ali: Among Talh trees with flowers (or fruits) piled one above another,-
29.shakir: And banana-trees (with fruits), one above another.
29.mohsin_khan: Among Talh (banana-trees) with fruits piled one above another,

30.muhammad_sarwar: with fruits piled up one on the other,

33.pickthall: Neither out of reach nor yet forbidden,
33.yusuf_ali: Whose season is not limited, nor (supply) forbidden,
33.mohsin_khan: Whose season is not limited, and their supply will not be cut off,

34.yusuf_ali: And on Thrones (of Dignity), raised high.
34.mohsin_khan: And on couches or thrones, raised high.

35.sahih_international: Indeed, We have produced the women of Paradise in a [new] creation
35.pickthall: Lo! We have created them a (new) creation
35.yusuf_ali: We have created (their Companions) of special creation.
35.shakir: Surely We have made them to grow into a (new) growth,
35.mohsin_khan: Verily, We have created them (maidens) of special creation.

36.yusuf_ali: And made them virgin - pure (and undefiled), -
36.shakir: Then We have made them virgins,
36.muhammad_sarwar: that We have created (for the people of the right hand).
36.arberry: and We made them spotless virgins,

37.sahih_international: Devoted [to their husbands] and of equal age,
37.mohsin_khan: Loving (their husbands only), equal in age.

38.sahih_international: For the companions of the right [who are]
38.pickthall: For those on the right hand;
38.yusuf_ali: For the Companions of the Right Hand.
38.shakir: For the sake of the companions of the right hand.
38.mohsin_khan: For those on the Right Hand.
38.arberry: like of age for the Companions of the Right.

39.sahih_international: A company of the former peoples
39.pickthall: A multitude of those of old
39.yusuf_ali: A (goodly) number from those of old,
39.shakir: A numerous company from among the first,
39.muhammad_sarwar: These (people of the right hand) consist of many from the ancient
39.mohsin_khan: A multitude of those (on the Right Hand) will be from the first generation (who embraced Islam).

40.sahih_international: And a company of the later peoples.
40.pickthall: And a multitude of those of later time.
40.yusuf_ali: And a (goodly) number from those of later times.
40.shakir: And a numerous company from among the last.
40.muhammad_sarwar: and many from the later generations.
40.mohsin_khan: And a multitude of those (on the Right Hand) will be from the later times (generations).
40.arberry: and a throng of the later folk.

41.sahih_international: And the companions of the left - what are the companions of the left?
41.pickthall: And those on the left hand: What of those on the left hand?
41.yusuf_ali: The Companions of the Left Hand,- what will be the Companions of the Left Hand?
41.shakir: And those of the left hand, how wretched are those of the left hand!
41.muhammad_sarwar: As for the people on the left hand, how miserable they will be!
41.mohsin_khan: And those on the Left Hand Who will be those on the Left Hand?
41.arberry: The Companions of the Left (O Companions of the Left!)

42.sahih_international: [They will be] in scorching fire and scalding water
42.pickthall: In scorching wind and scalding water
42.yusuf_ali: (They will be) in the midst of a Fierce Blast of Fire and in Boiling Water,
42.shakir: In hot wind and boiling water,
42.muhammad_sarwar: They will live amid the scorching,
42.mohsin_khan: In fierce hot wind and boiling water,
42.arberry: mid burning winds and boiling waters

43.sahih_international: And a shade of black smoke,
43.yusuf_ali: And in the shades of Black Smoke:
43.shakir: And the shade of black smoke,
43.muhammad_sarwar: scalding water and under a shadow of black smoke,
43.arberry: and the shadow of a smoking blaze

44.yusuf_ali: Nothing (will there be) to refresh, nor to please:
44.muhammad_sarwar: neither cold nor graceful in shape.

45.sahih_international: Indeed they were, before that, indulging in affluence,
45.pickthall: Lo! heretofore they were effete with luxury
45.yusuf_ali: For that they were wont to be indulged, before that, in wealth (and luxury),
45.shakir: Surely they were before that made to live in ease and plenty.
45.muhammad_sarwar: They had lived in luxury before this
45.mohsin_khan: Verily, before that, they indulged in luxury,
45.arberry: and before that they lived at ease,

46.sahih_international: And they used to persist in the great violation,
46.pickthall: And used to persist in the awful sin.
46.yusuf_ali: And persisted obstinately in wickedness supreme!
46.shakir: And they persisted in the great violation.
46.mohsin_khan: And were persisting in great sin (joining partners in worship along with Allah, committing murders and other crimes, etc.)
46.arberry: and persisted in the Great Sin,

47.sahih_international: And they used to say, "When we die and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?
47.pickthall: And they used to say: When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we then, forsooth, be raised again,
47.yusuf_ali: And they used to say, "What! when we die and become dust and bones, shall we then indeed be raised up again?-
47.shakir: And they used to say: What! when we die and have become dust and bones, shall we then indeed be raised?
47.muhammad_sarwar: It was they who said, "Shall we be resurrected after we die and have turned into dust and bones?
47.mohsin_khan: And they used to say: "When we die and become dust and bones, shall we then indeed be resurrected?
47.arberry: ever saying, 'What, when we are dead and become dust and bones, shall we indeed be raised up?

48.muhammad_sarwar: Will our ancient forefathers be resurrected too?
48.arberry: What, and our fathers, the ancients?'

49.sahih_international: Say, [O Muhammad], "Indeed, the former and the later peoples
49.pickthall: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Lo! those of old and those of later time
49.yusuf_ali: Say: "Yea, those of old and those of later times,
49.shakir: Say: The first and the last,
49.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), say, "All the ancient and later generations
49.mohsin_khan: Say (O Muhammad SAW): "(Yes) verily, those of old, and those of later times.
49.arberry: Say: 'The ancients, and the later folk

50.sahih_international: Are to be gathered together for the appointment of a known Day."
50.pickthall: Will all be brought together to the tryst of an appointed day.
50.yusuf_ali: "All will certainly be gathered together for the meeting appointed for a Day well-known.
50.shakir: Shall most surely be gathered together for the appointed hour of a known day.
50.muhammad_sarwar: will be brought together for an appointment on an appointed day.
50.mohsin_khan: "All will surely be gathered together for appointed Meeting of a known Day.
50.arberry: shall be gathered to the appointed time of a known day.

51.sahih_international: Then indeed you, O those astray [who are] deniers,
51.pickthall: Then lo! ye, the erring, the deniers,
51.yusuf_ali: "Then will ye truly,- O ye that go wrong, and treat (Truth) as Falsehood!-
51.shakir: Then shall you, O you who err and call it a lie!
51.muhammad_sarwar: Then you people who had gone astray and rejected the Truth
51.mohsin_khan: "Then moreover, verily, you the erring-ones, the deniers (of Resurrection)!
51.arberry: Then you erring ones, you that cried lies,

52.sahih_international: Will be eating from trees of zaqqum
52.pickthall: Ye verily will eat of a tree called Zaqqum
52.yusuf_ali: "Ye will surely taste of the Tree of Zaqqum.
52.shakir: Most surely eat of a tree of Zaqqoom,
52.muhammad_sarwar: will eat from the fruit of the tree of Zaqqum,
52.mohsin_khan: "You verily will eat of the trees of Zaqqum.
52.arberry: you shall eat of a tree called Zakkoum,

53.sahih_international: And filling with it your bellies
53.pickthall: And will fill your bellies therewith;
53.yusuf_ali: "Then will ye fill your insides therewith,
53.mohsin_khan: "Then you will fill your bellies therewith,
53.arberry: and you shall fill therewith your bellies

54.sahih_international: And drinking on top of it from scalding water
54.pickthall: And thereon ye will drink of boiling water,
54.yusuf_ali: "And drink Boiling Water on top of it:
54.shakir: Then drink over it of boiling water;
54.muhammad_sarwar: and on top of this you will drink boiling water
54.mohsin_khan: "And drink boiling water on top of it,
54.arberry: and drink on top of that boiling water

55.sahih_international: And will drink as the drinking of thirsty camels.
55.pickthall: Drinking even as the camel drinketh.
55.yusuf_ali: "Indeed ye shall drink like diseased camels raging with thirst!"
55.shakir: And drink as drinks the thirsty camel.
55.mohsin_khan: "So you will drink (that) like thirsty camels!"
55.arberry: lapping it down like thirsty camels.'

56.sahih_international: That is their accommodation on the Day of Recompense.
56.pickthall: This will be their welcome on the Day of Judgment.
56.yusuf_ali: Such will be their entertainment on the Day of Requital!
56.shakir: This is their entertainment on the day of requital.
56.muhammad_sarwar: Such will be their dwelling on the Day of Judgment.
56.mohsin_khan: That will be their entertainment on the Day of Recompense!
56.arberry: This shall be their hospitality on the Day of Doom.

57.sahih_international: We have created you, so why do you not believe?
57.pickthall: We created you. Will ye then admit the truth?
57.yusuf_ali: It is We Who have created you: why will ye not witness the Truth?
57.shakir: We have created you, why do you not then assent?
57.muhammad_sarwar: It is We who have created you. Why then did you not testify to the Truth?
57.mohsin_khan: We created you, then why do you believe not?
57.arberry: We created you; therefore why will you not believe?

58.sahih_international: Have you seen that which you emit?
58.pickthall: Have ye seen that which ye emit?
58.yusuf_ali: Do ye then see?- The (human Seed) that ye throw out,-
58.mohsin_khan: Then tell Me (about) the human semen that you emit.
58.arberry: Have you considered the seed you spill?

59.sahih_international: Is it you who creates it, or are We the Creator?
59.pickthall: Do ye create it or are We the Creator?
59.yusuf_ali: Is it ye who create it, or are We the Creators?
59.shakir: Is it you that create it or are We the creators?
59.muhammad_sarwar: Did you create it or was it We who created it?
59.mohsin_khan: Is it you who create it (i.e. make this semen into a perfect human being), or are We the Creator?
59.arberry: Do you yourselves create it, or are We the Creators?

60.sahih_international: We have decreed death among you, and We are not to be outdone
60.pickthall: We mete out death among you, and We are not to be outrun,
60.yusuf_ali: We have decreed Death to be your common lot, and We are not to be frustrated
60.shakir: We have ordained death among you and We are not to be overcome,
60.muhammad_sarwar: We have destined death for you and no one can challenge Us
60.mohsin_khan: We have decreed death to you all, and We are not unable,
60.arberry: We have decreed among you Death; We shall not be outstripped;

61.sahih_international: In that We will change your likenesses and produce you in that [form] which you do not know.
61.pickthall: That We may transfigure you and make you what ye know not.
61.yusuf_ali: from changing your Forms and creating you (again) in (forms) that ye know not.
61.shakir: In order that We may bring in your place the likes of you and make you grow into what you know not.
61.muhammad_sarwar: in replacing you with another creation like you, changing you into a form which you do not know.
61.mohsin_khan: To transfigure you and create you in (forms) that you know not.
61.arberry: that We may exchange the likes of you, and make you to grow again in a fashion you know not.

62.sahih_international: And you have already known the first creation, so will you not remember?
62.pickthall: And verily ye know the first creation. Why, then, do ye not reflect?
62.yusuf_ali: And ye certainly know already the first form of creation: why then do ye not celebrate His praises?
62.shakir: And certainly you know the first growth, why do you not then mind?
62.muhammad_sarwar: You certainly knew about (your) first development. Why do you not take heed?
62.mohsin_khan: And indeed, you have already known the first form of creation (i.e. the creation of Adam), why then do you not remember or take heed?
62.arberry: You have known the first growth; so why will you not remember?

63.sahih_international: And have you seen that [seed] which you sow?
63.pickthall: Have ye seen that which ye cultivate?
63.yusuf_ali: See ye the seed that ye sow in the ground?
63.shakir: Have you considered what you sow?
63.muhammad_sarwar: Have you seen what you sow?
63.mohsin_khan: Tell Me! The seed that you sow in the ground.
63.arberry: Have you considered the soil you till?

64.sahih_international: Is it you who makes it grow, or are We the grower?
64.pickthall: Is it ye who foster it, or are We the Fosterer?
64.yusuf_ali: Is it ye that cause it to grow, or are We the Cause?
64.shakir: Is it you that cause it to grow, or are We the causers of growth?
64.muhammad_sarwar: Do you make it grow or is it We who make it grow?
64.mohsin_khan: Is it you that make it grow, or are We the Grower?
64.arberry: Do you yourselves sow it, or are We the Sowers?

65.sahih_international: If We willed, We could make it [dry] debris, and you would remain in wonder,
65.pickthall: If We willed, We verily could make it chaff, then would ye cease not to exclaim:
65.yusuf_ali: Were it Our Will, We could crumble it to dry powder, and ye would be left in wonderment,
65.shakir: If We pleased, We should have certainly made it broken down into pieces, then would you begin to lament:
65.muhammad_sarwar: Had We wanted, We could have crushed it to bits and you would have been left to lament,
65.mohsin_khan: Were it Our Will, We could crumble it to dry pieces, and you would be regretful (or left in wonderment).
65.arberry: Did We will, We would make it broken orts, and you would remain bitterly jesting --

66.pickthall: Lo! we are laden with debt!
66.yusuf_ali: (Saying), "We are indeed left with debts (for nothing):
66.shakir: Surely we are burdened with debt:
66.muhammad_sarwar: crying, "We have been left to suffer loss.
66.mohsin_khan: (Saying): "We are indeed Mughramun (i.e. ruined or lost the money without any profit, or punished by the loss of all that we spend for cultivation, etc.)! [See Tafsir Al-Qurtubi, Vol. 17, Page 219]

67.yusuf_ali: "Indeed are we shut out (of the fruits of our labour)"
67.muhammad_sarwar: Surely, we have been deprived (of the benefits)".

68.sahih_international: And have you seen the water that you drink?
68.pickthall: Have ye observed the water which ye drink?
68.yusuf_ali: See ye the water which ye drink?
68.shakir: Have you considered the water which you drink?
68.muhammad_sarwar: Have you seen the water which you drink?
68.mohsin_khan: Tell Me! The water that you drink.
68.arberry: Have you considered the water you drink?

69.sahih_international: Is it you who brought it down from the clouds, or is it We who bring it down?
69.pickthall: Is it ye who shed it from the raincloud, or are We the Shedder?
69.yusuf_ali: Do ye bring it down (in rain) from the cloud or do We?
69.shakir: Is it you that send it down from the clouds, or are We the senders?
69.muhammad_sarwar: Is it you who sent it down from the clouds or is it We who have sent it down?
69.mohsin_khan: Is it you who cause it from the rainclouds to come down, or are We the Causer of it to come down?
69.arberry: Did you send it down from the clouds, or did We send it?

70.sahih_international: If We willed, We could make it bitter, so why are you not grateful?
70.pickthall: If We willed We verily could make it bitter. Why then, give ye not thanks?
70.yusuf_ali: Were it Our Will, We could make it salt (and unpalatable): then why do ye not give thanks?
70.shakir: If We pleased, We would have made it salty; why do you not then give thanks?
70.muhammad_sarwar: Had We wanted, We could have made it salty. Why then do you not give thanks?
70.mohsin_khan: If We willed, We verily could make it salt (and undrinkable), why then do you not give thanks (to Allah)?
70.arberry: Did We will, We would make it bitter; so why are you not thankful?

71.sahih_international: And have you seen the fire that you ignite?
71.pickthall: Have ye observed the fire which ye strike out;
71.yusuf_ali: See ye the Fire which ye kindle?
71.shakir: Have you considered the fire which you strike?
71.muhammad_sarwar: Have you seen the fire which you kindle?
71.mohsin_khan: Tell Me! The fire which you kindle,
71.arberry: Have you considered the fire you kindle?

72.sahih_international: Is it you who produced its tree, or are We the producer?
72.pickthall: Was it ye who made the tree thereof to grow, or were We the grower?
72.yusuf_ali: Is it ye who grow the tree which feeds the fire, or do We grow it?
72.shakir: Is it you that produce the trees for it, or are We the producers?
72.muhammad_sarwar: Is it you who have produced its tree or is it We who have produced it?
72.mohsin_khan: Is it you who made the tree thereof to grow, or are We the Grower?
72.arberry: Did you make its timber to grow, or did We make it?

73.sahih_international: We have made it a reminder and provision for the travelers,
73.pickthall: We, even We, appointed it a memorial and a comfort for the dwellers in the wilderness.
73.yusuf_ali: We have made it a memorial (of Our handiwork), and an article of comfort and convenience for the denizens of deserts.
73.shakir: We have made it a reminder and an advantage for the wayfarers of the desert.
73.muhammad_sarwar: It is We who have made it as a reminder and a means of comfort for the people.
73.mohsin_khan: We have made it a Reminder (for the Hell-fire, in the Hereafter); and an article of use for the travellers (and all the others, in this world).
73.arberry: We Ourselves made it for a reminder, and a boon to the desert-dwellers.

74.sahih_international: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.
74.pickthall: Therefor (O Muhammad), praise the name of thy Lord, the Tremendous.
74.yusuf_ali: Then celebrate with praises the name of thy Lord, the Supreme!
74.shakir: Therefore glorify the name of your Lord, the Great.
74.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), glorify your Lord, the Great One.
74.mohsin_khan: Then glorify with praises the Name of your Lord, the Most Great.
74.arberry: Then magnify the Name of thy Lord, the All-mighty.

75.sahih_international: Then I swear by the setting of the stars,
75.pickthall: Nay, I swear by the places of the stars -
75.yusuf_ali: Furthermore I call to witness the setting of the Stars,-
75.shakir: But nay! I swear by the falling of stars;
75.muhammad_sarwar: I do not need to swear by the setting of the stars
75.mohsin_khan: So I swear by Mawaqi (setting or the mansions, etc.) of the stars (they traverse).
75.arberry: No! I swear by the fallings of the stars

76.sahih_international: And indeed, it is an oath - if you could know - [most] great.
76.pickthall: And lo! that verily is a tremendous oath, if ye but knew -
76.yusuf_ali: And that is indeed a mighty adjuration if ye but knew,-
76.shakir: And most surely it is a very great oath if you only knew;
76.muhammad_sarwar: - which is indeed a great oath if only you knew it -
76.mohsin_khan: And verily, that is indeed a great oath, if you but know.
76.arberry: (and that is indeed a mighty oath, did you but know it)

77.sahih_international: Indeed, it is a noble Qur'an
77.pickthall: That (this) is indeed a noble Qur'an
77.yusuf_ali: That this is indeed a qur'an Most Honourable,
77.shakir: Most surely it is an honored Quran,
77.muhammad_sarwar: that this is an honorable Quran
77.mohsin_khan: That (this) is indeed an honourable recital (the Noble Quran).
77.arberry: it is surely a noble Koran

78.shakir: In a book that is protected
78.muhammad_sarwar: preserved in a hidden Book which
78.mohsin_khan: In a Book well-guarded (with Allah in the heaven i.e. Al-Lauh Al-Mahfuz).

79.sahih_international: None touch it except the purified.
79.pickthall: Which none toucheth save the purified,
79.yusuf_ali: Which none shall touch but those who are clean:
79.shakir: None shall touch it save the purified ones.
79.muhammad_sarwar: no one can touch it except the purified ones.
79.mohsin_khan: Which (that Book with Allah) none can touch but the purified (i.e. the angels).
79.arberry: none but the purified shall touch,

80.sahih_international: [It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.
80.pickthall: A revelation from the Lord of the Worlds.
80.yusuf_ali: A Revelation from the Lord of the Worlds.
80.shakir: A revelation by the Lord of the worlds.
80.muhammad_sarwar: (This Quran) is a revelation from the Lord of the Universe.
80.mohsin_khan: A Revelation (this Quran) from the Lord of the 'Alamin (mankind, jinns and all that exists).
80.arberry: a sending down from the Lord of all Being.

81.sahih_international: Then is it to this statement that you are indifferent
81.pickthall: Is it this Statement that ye scorn,
81.yusuf_ali: Is it such a Message that ye would hold in light esteem?
81.shakir: Do you then hold this announcement in contempt?
81.muhammad_sarwar: Would you say that this statement is a lie?
81.mohsin_khan: Is it such a talk (this Quran) that you (disbelievers) deny?
81.arberry: What, do you hold this discourse in disdain,

82.sahih_international: And make [the thanks for] your provision that you deny [the Provider]?
82.pickthall: And make denial thereof your livelihood?
82.yusuf_ali: And have ye made it your livelihood that ye should declare it false?
82.shakir: And to give (it) the lie you make your means of subsistence.
82.muhammad_sarwar: Would you reject the sustenance that you receive rather than give thanks?
82.mohsin_khan: And instead (of thanking Allah) for the provision He gives you, on the contrary, you deny Him (by disbelief)!
82.arberry: and do you make it your living to cry lies?

83.sahih_international: Then why, when the soul at death reaches the throat
83.pickthall: Why, then, when (the soul) cometh up to the throat (of the dying)
83.yusuf_ali: Then why do ye not (intervene) when (the soul of the dying man) reaches the throat,-
83.shakir: Why is it not then that when it (soul) comes up to the throat,
83.muhammad_sarwar: Why can you not help a soul dying
83.mohsin_khan: Then why do you not (intervene) when (the soul of a dying person) reaches the throat?
83.arberry: Why, but when the soul leaps to the throat of the dying

84.sahih_international: And you are at that time looking on -
84.pickthall: And ye are at that moment looking
84.yusuf_ali: And ye the while (sit) looking on,-
84.shakir: And you at that time look on--
84.mohsin_khan: And you at the moment are looking on,
84.arberry: and that hour you are watching

85.sahih_international: And Our angels are nearer to him than you, but you do not see -
85.pickthall: - And We are nearer unto him than ye are, but ye see not -
85.yusuf_ali: But We are nearer to him than ye, and yet see not,-
85.shakir: And We are nearer to it than you, but you do not see--
85.muhammad_sarwar: We are closer to him than you, but you cannot see.
85.mohsin_khan: But We (i.e. Our angels who take the soul) are nearer to him than you, but you see not, [Tafsir At-Tabari, Vol. 27, Page 209]
85.arberry: (And We are nigher him than you, but you do not see Us)

86.sahih_international: Then why do you not, if you are not to be recompensed,
86.pickthall: Why then, if ye are not in bondage (unto Us),
86.yusuf_ali: Then why do ye not,- If you are exempt from (future) account,-
86.shakir: Then why is it not-- if you are not held under authority--
86.muhammad_sarwar: If you are true to your claim that there is no Day of Judgment,
86.mohsin_khan: Then why do you not, if you are exempt from the reckoning and recompense (punishment, etc.)
86.arberry: why, if you are not at Our disposal,

87.sahih_international: Bring it back, if you should be truthful?
87.pickthall: Do ye not force it back, if ye are truthful?
87.yusuf_ali: Call back the soul, if ye are true (in the claim of independence)?
87.shakir: That you send it (not) back-- if you are truthful?
87.muhammad_sarwar: why can you not bring it (the soul) back (to life)?
87.mohsin_khan: Bring back the soul (to its body), if you are truthful?
87.arberry: do you not bring back his soul, if you speak truly?

88.sahih_international: And if the deceased was of those brought near to Allah,
88.pickthall: Thus if he is of those brought nigh,
88.yusuf_ali: Thus, then, if he be of those Nearest to Allah,
88.shakir: Then if he is one of those drawn nigh (to Allah),
88.muhammad_sarwar: (If a dying soul) is of those near to God,
88.mohsin_khan: Then, if he (the dying person) be of the Muqarrabun (those brought near to Allah),
88.arberry: Then, if he be of those brought nigh the Throne,

89.sahih_international: Then [for him is] rest and bounty and a garden of pleasure.
89.pickthall: Then breath of life, and plenty, and a Garden of delight.
89.yusuf_ali: (There is for him) Rest and Satisfaction, and a Garden of Delights.
89.shakir: Then happiness and bounty and a garden of bliss.
89.muhammad_sarwar: it will have rest, happiness, and a beautiful Paradise.
89.mohsin_khan: (There is for him) rest and provision, and a Garden of delights (Paradise).
89.arberry: there shall be repose and ease, and a Garden of Delight;

90.sahih_international: And if he was of the companions of the right,
90.pickthall: And if he is of those on the right hand,
90.yusuf_ali: And if he be of the Companions of the Right Hand,
90.shakir: And if he is one of those on the right hand,
90.muhammad_sarwar: If it is of the people of the right hand,
90.mohsin_khan: And if he (the dying person) be of those on the Right Hand,
90.arberry: and if he be a Companion of the Right:

91.sahih_international: Then [the angels will say], "Peace for you; [you are] from the companions of the right."
91.pickthall: Then (the greeting) "Peace be unto thee" from those on the right hand.
91.yusuf_ali: (For him is the salutation), "Peace be unto thee", from the Companions of the Right Hand.
91.shakir: Then peace to you from those on the right hand.
91.muhammad_sarwar: it will be with the people of the right hand, living in peace and security.
91.mohsin_khan: Then there is safety and peace (from the Punishment of Allah) for (you as you are from) those on the Right Hand.
91.arberry: 'Peace be upon thee, Companion of the Right!'

92.sahih_international: But if he was of the deniers [who were] astray,
92.pickthall: But if he is of the rejecters, the erring,
92.yusuf_ali: And if he be of those who treat (Truth) as Falsehood, who go wrong,
92.shakir: And if he is one of the rejecters, the erring ones,
92.muhammad_sarwar: If it is of those who have rejected the Truth and have gone astray,
92.mohsin_khan: But if he (the dying person) be of the denying (of the Resurrection), the erring (away from the Right Path of Islamic Monotheism),
92.arberry: But if he be of them that cried lies, and went astray,

93.sahih_international: Then [for him is] accommodation of scalding water
93.pickthall: Then the welcome will be boiling water
93.yusuf_ali: For him is Entertainment with Boiling Water.
93.shakir: He shall have an entertainment of boiling water,
93.muhammad_sarwar: its dwelling will be boiling water
93.mohsin_khan: Then for him is entertainment with boiling water.
93.arberry: there shall be a hospitality of boiling water

94.muhammad_sarwar: and the heat of hell fire.

95.sahih_international: Indeed, this is the true certainty,
95.yusuf_ali: Verily, this is the Very Truth and Certainly.
95.shakir: Most surely this is a certain truth.
95.muhammad_sarwar: This is the absolute Truth and certainty.
95.mohsin_khan: Verily, this! This is an absolute Truth with certainty.
95.arberry: Surely this is the truth of certainty.

96.sahih_international: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.
96.pickthall: Therefor (O Muhammad) praise the name of thy Lord, the Tremendous.
96.yusuf_ali: So celebrate with praises the name of thy Lord, the Supreme.
96.shakir: Therefore glorify the name of your Lord, the Great.
96.muhammad_sarwar: So glorify the name of your Lord, the Great One.
96.mohsin_khan: So glorify with praises the Name of your Lord, the Most Great.
96.arberry: Then magnify the Name of thy Lord, the All-mighty.
